conviction_note: Q1 is running about 3.4pt below the company's own same-store premise (99.5% against 102.9% for H1), so the print should come in near 46-48% of the H1 ordinary plan against kabutan's 5-year average of 62.6%. Last year's Q1 gapped -5.5% on a smaller miss whose progress rate matched that average. I take half a point off the -2.0 finding because the monthly figures are public, the stock is already -10.7% over 20 sessions (peers -4 to -7%), and Oasis (16.14%) has been buying.
bar: Company H1 FY5/27 guide: sales 318.0bn, OP 15.5bn, ordinary 14.9bn, built on an H1 existing-store premise of 102.9% (FY5/26 results presentation p.18, https://kusuri-aoki-hd.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/202605_4Q_presentation_v3.pdf; tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260702/140120260702586782.pdf). Last year Q1 was 53.5% of H1 ordinary, so the plan implies a Q1 ordinary of about 7.97bn; my estimate is about 7.0bn (-12%). The sell-side bar is not resolved. IFIS consensus Q1 ordinary is 7,350m (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3549). Yahoo's single-analyst Q1 EPS of 46.47 implies about 6.4bn ordinary (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/3549.T?modules=earningsTrend). The two disagree, so the finding is capped small.

findings.finding: Q1 (2026-05-21 to 08-20) existing-store sales ran 97.5% / 100.3% / 100.7% (about 99.5%) against the 102.9% H1 premise behind the +14.9% H1 OP guide. With all-store sales at about 109% plus a roughly 2pt Spot M&A contribution, Q1 sales come to about 154-155bn, against about 158.6bn implied by the plan. On a mostly fixed SG&A base that puts OP at about 7.0-7.4bn (flat to -4% YoY) and ordinary at about 6.8-7.1bn: around 46-48% of the H1 ordinary plan, against the 62.6% five-year average kabutan prints mechanically.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close-to-next-open on the actual print dates: Q1 FY5/26 (2025-10-02) gapped -5.5%. That print had OP -1% YoY, about 0.5bn below consensus, and a progress rate in line with the 5-year average (kabutan k202510020008; Fisco via kabutan n202510030563). Q1 FY5/25 (2024-10-03) gapped +3.66% on strong growth. Other prints: +0.34, -2.08, +1.91, +19.1 (special dividend and buyback), +1.86, +5.69 (aggressive FY27 guide). Median absolute about 2.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, which is why it is small. The monthly numbers are public, the stock is -10.7% over 20 sessions against peers -4 to -7%, and IFIS consensus FY ordinary (28.9bn) already sits below the company's 30.8bn. What is not priced: the IFIS Q1 ordinary consensus of 7,350m (+0.9% YoY) has not been marked to the sub-100 same-store run. If it had, the Q1 bar would be at or below last year's 7,284m. Nothing has been revised either, so the release will mechanically print a progress rate about 15pt below the 5-year average, and kabutan's headline generator will say so. Last year a print with a normal progress rate still gapped -5.5%.
findings.independence: Same-store premise from a different document (FY5/26 results presentation p.18): https://kusuri-aoki-hd.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/202605_4Q_presentation_v3.pdf. Fisco on the July guide flagged it as 'ややチャレンジング' because of the weak June: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3549&b=n202607030783. The September monthly lands at 15:30 with the print, against a hot-September 2025 base of 103.4% and late-August heavy-rain closures in Ishikawa/Toyama (https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOCC273100X20C26A8000000/). It points the same way but rests on the same same-store-vs-plan thesis, so it is folded in here and not counted twice.

outside_window.finding: The 24bn / 6.0m-share buyback authorised 2025-12-25 (runs to 2026-12-25) had bought 0 shares by 2026-08-31. Unused capacity of about 6.3% of shares could be executed (incl. ToSTNeT-3) before expiry, but nothing dates it inside the window.

Oasis Management keeps adding (16.14% as of 2026-09-09) and opposed the president's reappointment, which passed with only 65.2% support at the 2026-08-19 AGM. Any proposal or tender is undated and falls outside the window.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the tape (run-up -10.7% over 20d and -7.6% over 5d, beyond the sector), so part of it is already in the price. It cuts against the free control (-run_up implies a bounce) and the small positive lean (+0.15). So the emitted move is smaller than the finding.
